# Visible Body

> > Visible Body provides interactive 3D anatomy and physiology software including Human Anatomy Atlas, Courseware, and the Visible Body Suite for medical and biology education.

Visible Body offers comprehensive 3D anatomical models and educational tools used by students, educators, and healthcare professionals worldwide. Their products include Human Anatomy Atlas, Anatomy & Function, Heart & Circulatory Premium, and Visible Body Courseware for teaching anatomy, physiology, and biology across multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Human Anatomy Atlas
- Visible Body Suite
- Visible Body Courseware
- 3D anatomical models
- Anatomy education
- Medical education
- Skeletal system

- Biology education

## Products & Pricing

- [Visible Body Suite - 合理定价，轻松选择](https://www.visiblebody.com/zh/vb-suite-pricing): Visible Body Suite pricing and subscription plans (Chinese version)
- [Anatomy & Function－基本的な人体の解剖学的構造と機能について確認します](https://www.visiblebody.com/ja/anatomy-and-physiology-apps/anatomy-and-function): Anatomy & Function app for 3D anatomical structures (Japanese version)
- [Herz und Kreislauf Premium - Erforschen Sie das Herz und die Gefäßanatomie](https://www.visiblebody.com/de/anatomy-and-physiology-apps/heart-and-circulatory-premium): Heart & Circulatory Premium app with 3D cardiovascular models (German)
- [Visible Body 学習サイト](https://www.visiblebody.com/ja/learn): Free human body systems learning site (Japanese version)

## Anatomy Learning Resources

- [Types of Bones | Learn Skeleton Anatomy](https://www.visiblebody.com/learn/skeleton/types-of-bones): Bone classification and skeletal system anatomy educational guide
- [Urinary System Structures](https://www.visiblebody.com/learn/urinary/urinary-system-structures): Kidneys, ureters, bladder, and urethra anatomy and filtration function
- [Tipos de músculos | Aprenda sobre anatomía muscular](https://www.visiblebody.com/es/learn/muscular/muscle-types): Muscle tissue types: skeletal, cardiac, and smooth (Spanish version)
- [Pathologies du système urinaire](https://www.visiblebody.com/fr/learn/urinary/urinary-system-pathologies-common-diseases-and-disorders): Urinary system disorders: kidney stones, incontinence, PKD (French version)

## Anatomy & Physiology Educational Content

- [Anatomy and Physiology: Phonation and the Larynx](https://www.visiblebody.com/blog/anatomy-and-physiology-phonation-and-the-larynx): Laryngeal muscles and vocal cord anatomy for speech production
- [Physiology & Pathology: Four Common Cardiovascular Conditions](https://www.visiblebody.com/blog/physiology-pathology-four-common-cardiovascular-conditions): Overview of coronary artery disease, atherosclerosis, and heart attacks
- [Anatomy and Physiology: Major Components of the Digestive System](https://www.visiblebody.com/blog/anatomy-and-physiology-major-components-of-the-digestive-system): Digestive system anatomy from oral cavity to stomach using Human Anatomy Atlas
- [3D Skeletal System: Atlas, Axis, and the Atlanto-Axial Relationship](https://www.visiblebody.com/blog/3d-skeletal-system-atlas-axis-and-the-atlanto-axial-relationship): Cervical vertebrae atlas and axis form pivot joint for head movement
